title: connector receive response, v0
description: 200 body of POST /v0/contributions/connector/receive: the plugin's verdict on one relayed delivery and the answer the core returns to the source. accepted: the delivery is authentic; the core ingests its items (the fetch item shape, without attachments) before answering, so an item a pull run also returns converges on the same Receipt. refused: the delivery is not authentic or not addressed to this instance; the core returns the answer and changes nothing.

response.description: What the core answers the source: a 2xx status for accepted, a 4xx status for refused. A challenge (such as a CRC check) is an accepted delivery with no items whose body is the challenge answer.

body.description: Text body returned to the source.

items.description: Items the delivery carries, at most the declared max_items. Only with verdict accepted; attachments are not supported in a delivery.

reads.description: Source resources the delivery counts as read; feeds the per-UTC-day usage counters.
